_readme: S750, the cheap piles (2026-11-28). Plan s750a files the reading state_course_not_on_page (kb/_program_named_gaps.py, S748) where the committed capture finds a state-listed course on no line of the program's own page. The reading's fires are wrong about 4 times in 100, so each row is checked against a free read of its own page before it is planned: this read prints the page so a session and the plan's second reader can see whether any line prints the course. No model call, nothing written. Irvine Valley Digital Media Art certificate 44922: DMA 75. The entry is read as the capture reads it (cq_view, catalog 4690).

questions.dma_75: Whether the Digital Media Art certificate's entry prints DMA 75 on any line, and each DMA row it prints.

46149637666.dma_75: no line of the Digital Media Art certificate's entry (node 51441, its Requirements and Summary pages) prints DMA 75 or any 75; it prints 12 DMA codes: DMA 10, DMA 12, DMA 51, DMA 55, DMA 65, DMA 70, DMA 192, DMA 52, DMA 56, DMA 62, DMA 175, DMA 195; and Total : 24.0
46149637666._what: A session's findings over the run's log (not quoted lines): the rows the page prints, counted by a scratch script from the downloaded log and read by eye. kb/_program_piles_s750a.py cites them beside the capture's own finding.
46149637666._rows_what: For each question, the course codes of the missing course's subject that the page prints, as printed (Palomar: every course code the page prints), in page order, each once: tests/program_piles_s750a_test.py reads them against the capture's codes_found.
